title: Automotive Service Technician
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: AUTOMOTIVE SERVICE TECHNICIAN CERTIFICATE OF ACHIEVEMENT
outcomes: Demonstrate fundamental technical skills essential for all automotive service and repair technicians, specifically in the area of brake systems. This includes proficiency in tool selection, usage, and maintenance, practical measurement techniques, as well as understanding of terminology and system functions.

notes: Catalog prints AUTO 51.20 and AUTO 52.40; the closed list stores them as AUTO 51.2 and AUTO 52.4 (same courses, trailing zero dropped), so they are not marked as catalog additions.
Total of 20 units is printed as 'TOTAL UNITS REQUIRED FOR CERTIFICATE 20'; it matches 19 required units plus 1 unit from the experience list.
Career entry 'automotive industry' is taken from the description 'entry-level position in the automotive industry'; reviewer may judge whether it counts as a named career field.

The page also prints other automotive certificates (Emission Technician, Automotive Technology, Engine Performance, Transportation Engine Repair); only the Automotive Service Technician section was read.
